premises.text: Labor shortages in construction, agriculture, restaurants, and manufacturing create a large economic gap that factory-style robots do not serve
premises.evidence_span: There is a labor crisis in the US across the construction, agriculture, restaurant, and manufacturing industries, having a $1 trillion negative impact on the US economy

premises.text: Industrial robots use costly strain-wave gears, external control boxes, and extreme precision that everyday tasks do not need
premises.evidence_span: These industrial robots have big external control boxes with difficult-to-manufacture strain wave gears and legacy PLCs, limiting where robots need to go in the future. These robots are also focusing on costly, extreme precision

premises.text: Ally Arm uses cheaper planetary gears, integrated power (110AC/48V DC), novel joints, quick-change actuators, and application skins for right-tool everyday automation
premises.evidence_span: We've opted for proven planetary gears that are 97% efficient and 20% the cost of strain wave gears. We've removed the external control box

premises.text: Imitation learning / microbehaviors let non-experts program by demonstration instead of expensive professional training
premises.evidence_span: even my five-year-old will be able to program the robot by showing it, and the robot will then repeat that task

premises.text: NVIDIA Isaac collaboration provides edge compute, AI, and simulation tools for developers and non-developers
premises.evidence_span: We are collaborating with NVIDIA to adopt the Isaac platform for edge compute, AI, and simulation to accelerate our development

value.text: Smart, affordable, easy-to-service and simple-to-train robotics for anyone, anywhere

causal_links.evidence_span: We must create the right tool for the right job
significantly expand the market for robotic technology and everyday automation
The Ally Arm is both smart and simple

notes: Hardware feature list (gears, power, joint, actuator, skins) folded into one P3 mechanism/product package. LOI and monthly services excluded as traction. Machine vision + imitation learning + AI phrasing treated as the training stack with P4 as the core learn-by-showing claim.
